decisions.statement: Which of a page's keys have an address is read from the page types under `email-address-property`.
An address is written in lowercase.
The `@` divides the mailbox from the domain the address stands at.
A mailbox tagged after `+` is well formed.
An address reaching 254 characters is the longest there is.
An address longer than 254 characters is refused for its length alone.
A page is judged where the change has that page.
A value stated as a list is judged address by address.
A page stating no address is not judged.
Whether the domain an address stands at is reachable is not judged here.

definition: the check refusing a stated email address that is not well formed
